prompt: Compact Japanese Lighthouse no-results recovery panel. Original controls visible state/glyphs; Japanese mock secondary copy/layout. White surfaces. Top rounded search field exact 'カフェ' Regular14/24, small slate magnifier left, original filled slate circle with WHITE X at right (not naked X). First 場所 label only; its original glyph is offscreen/unknown, do not invent. Other source small glyphs: 買い物 grocery basket with contents; サービス solid center dot inside thick open-bottom ring; 請求 filled receipt with scalloped lower edge and two white horizontal lines; ヘルプ filled circle with white question mark. Slate utility glyphs quiet height about0.8times text height. Preserve selected Help state. Recovery body left: preserve original authored question-mark graphic's exact layer geometry/colors: teal rounded square, bright green inner circle, WHITE rounded question mark. This is protected graphic; do not flatten to plain mint question tile or recolor teal/brightgreen. Right exact heading '「カフェ」に一致する結果がありません' Meiryo Bold20/28, wrap naturally; helper exact 'ほかの言葉で検索するか、ヘルプを確認してください。' Regular14/24 gray. Bottom full-width rounded-pill primary 'ヘルプを開く' Regular14 white on restrained135deg #174C36/#1F6444/#2D8F5E green gradient. Compact balanced spacing, complete search/tabs/body/action without clipping. Bodyink#1D1D1D/meta#6E6E6E, neutral outlines, zero tracking; only no-results heading Bold, all tab/action labels Regular. No broad mint surfaces, extra images, buttons, device chrome or shadows. Original graphic and exact Help-selected/source5tab state authoritative. Static raster only, no actual search/help navigation.
reviewNotes: Source5tabs/Helpselected, filledcirclewhiteX, distinct category glyphs and layered teal/green/white help graphic restored. Nonheading tabs/action labels too bold, utilities oversized/gray, protected help graphic gained gradient/shading vs flat original. Target Regular labels/quiet slate glyphs and flat original graphic fills, preserve selectedstate/countlayout.
